department: Faculty V – Mechanical Engineering and Transport Systems

deadline.value: No application deadline is given on the faculty's doctoral studies page.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The general doctoral regulations require a supervision agreement with your supervisor as part of the application.
supervisor.quote: a supervision agreement (doctoral agreement) will be concluded between the applicant and their supervisor or supervisors

funding.value: The faculty page does not say whether doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: An undergraduate and a master's degree are required; academically outstanding bachelor's holders can be admitted by a qualification procedure.
entry_route.quote: an applicant must have successfully completed an undergraduate degree and a master’s degree

also.quote: Academically outstanding candidates with a bachelor’s degree, or with a master’s degree taken without first obtaining a bachelor’s, can be directly admitted to a doctoral degree on the basis of a qualification procedure

notes: Faculty V page: "You can complete one of the following doctorates at our faculty: Doctor of Engineering Sciences (Dr.-Ing.), Doctor of Natural Sciences (Dr. rer. nat.)". The general TU Berlin regulations apply to Faculty V.
